response.notes: E1/E2 (days 85-112): each candidate alone beats the no-covariate baseline. X01 scored +20.3% (CI +9.2 to +29.9) and X02 +32.1% (CI +19.6 to +42.9). Both gains emerged after about day 92: week 1 was near zero, then skill rose, which suggests a regime change. E3 (days 113-126, fresh): X02 adds +20.1% given X01 (CI +8.1 to +29.2, 12/2 days won, both weeks positive). That is solid out-of-sample evidence of incremental value. E4 (same days): X01 adds +5.6% given X02, but the CI of -6.2 to +16.4 includes zero and days won/lost are 8/6. Both weeks were positive but small (+3.7%, +7.0%). The two-covariate MAE was 0.781, versus 0.828 for X02 alone and 0.977 for X01 alone. No no-covariate baseline was run on days 113-126, so standalone skill there is inferred, not measured.

beliefs.reason: Useful alone in the recent regime (E1, +20.3%). Its incremental value given X02 is small and not statistically established (E4: +5.6%, CI -6.2 to +16.4, 8/6 days), though positive in both weeks. It is neither confirmed useful nor shown redundant.
Strong alone (E2, +32.1%, rising to +53.1% in days 106-112). It adds significant value beyond X01 on fresh days 113-126 (E3, +20.1%, CI +8.1 to +29.2, 12/2 days won, both weeks positive).

response.conclusion: Supported: X02 is predictive in the current regime and adds value beyond X01 on fresh out-of-sample days (E3, +20.1%, CI excludes zero). X01 is predictive on its own (E1), but its added value once X02 is included is uncertain (E4, +5.6%, CI -6.2 to +16.4). I include X01 for four reasons. Its point estimate is positive in both weekly parts. The combined forecast had the lowest MAE observed (0.781). The model is pretrained, so adding a covariate carries little fitting risk. Nothing indicates X01 harms forecasts. This inclusion is a judgement call, not an established finding; X02-only would be a defensible, near-equivalent choice. Caveats: both signals emerged only after roughly day 92, so the system appears non-stationary. All findings describe the recent regime and could change again. Earlier periods, where neither candidate helped, should not be read as permanent nulls either.
